newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Industria, Portucel lead Lisbon stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Industria, Portucel lead Lisbon stock rise.

text.p: 1655 GMT - Surging foreign bourses, the buoyant dollar and strong interest in selected stocks drove the Lisbon bourse higher on Wednesday, putting an abrupt end to three sessions of profit-taking.

*Given the euphoric mood abroad, traders said that the buying was likely to continue on Thursday. The PSI .PSI20 index closed 1.08 percent higher at 7,868.42, with overall cash trade totalling 17.4 billion escudos.

*Sonae Industria soared 7.5 percent, hitting a new high of 2,020 escudos before slipping slightly to close at 1,999. Portucel Industrial gained 4.3 percent, while Banco Comercial Portugues rose 3.1 percent.
*BCP will be amongst the first banks to present first half results and the market is optimistic about the numbers, expected next week.

*Traders could give no particular reason for the strength of Sonae other than the fact that it had underperformed the rest of the bourse so far this year and is also expected to post sharply higher profit in 1997.

*Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) bounced back powerfully after falling further than the rest of the market on Tuesday following the outlook downgrade for sister bank Banco Totta made by Standard & Poor's. ($1=181 escudos)
